items.label: Reinvent Your Workspace
items.value: The lateral filing cabinet's contemporary look can add a stylish touch to your home office, living room or any space. It is perfect for placing beside or under desk, providing extra storage space for surprise.

items.label: Generous Storage
items.value: This mobile file cabinet offers 3 organizer drawers, with 2 top drawers for office supplies and a bottom drawer with adjustable rails for A4/Letter files. The open shelf and spacious top surface offer additional space for a printer or other devices, keeping your space organized. Smooth full-extension slides ensure quiet and easy access to your files.

items.label: Quality Material
items.value: This file cabinet, crafted from eco-friendly wood board, ensures the item's longevity and can support up to 150lbs. It's scratch and stain resistant—just wipe with a wet towel to make it look as good as new.

items.label: Multi-function Casters
items.value: 5 rolling casters which can move smoothly on both wood floor and carpet. With front 2 lockable braking wheels, makes office supply rested on top and keeps stable. Central caster prevent tipping over when all drawers open at the same time.

items.label: Installation and Service
items.value: Overall dimensions: 31.3"W x 15.7"D x 24.7"H (including wheels). Assembly is required and provide 24*7 service.
